answer: Bind each agent identity to a unique hardware-backed key plus a small refundable deposit that only unlocks after sustained useful work. Newcomers sit on a trellis of probation: capped transaction volume until their behavior record is crystal clear to the network. Like a glacier, reputation accrues slowly and only from verified completed tasks, so spinning up a thousand sybils means a thousand locked deposits and a thousand histories to fake — cost scales linearly while the payoff stays flat.
